metadataRaw.title: Easiest Ways to Strengthen Your Back and Butt
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows the easiest ways to strengthen your back and butt to help PREVENT BACK PAIN.

These EASY, effective strengthening exercises will focus on recurring issues (such pain, tightness, stiffness, and achiness) due to a weak lower back and glutes (buttocks).

We're going to work the core, lower back, hips, glutes, buttock, and leg muscles together... everything needed to help maintain a strong lower back and pelvis.

As a note, all of the exercises hit the back and butt just a little bit differently, so go through them all and use what works best for you. Also, all of the movements can be done at home and require NO EQUIPMENT!

WATCH now for the easiest ways to strengthen your back and glutes!

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
0:10 Butt Walk
2:09 Dog and Fire Hydrant
4:58 Butterfly Thruster
8:17 Wall Glute Slider
